title: Moroccan Lamb Tagine
description: A traditional Moroccan dish made with tender lamb and warm spices, all slow-cooked in a flavorful tagine. Perfect for a special occasion or a cozy night in.
instructions: Heat the oil in the bottom of the tagine over medium heat.
Brown the lamb in batches until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per batch.
Remove the lamb from the tagine and set aside.
Add the onion to the tagine and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger, cumin, cinnamon, paprika, salt, and pepper to the tagine and cook for 1 minute.
Return the lamb to the tagine and add enough water to cover the meat.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the tagine and transfer it to the oven.
Bake the tagine at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Garnish with parsley and serve over couscous.
